subject: Capture compact customer wins for one-pager tile gallery
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-07-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Capture compact customer wins for one-pager tile gallery

Team —

Quick ask: the product marketing deck needs a 6-8 tile gallery of short customer wins for our upcoming enterprise one-pager pack. These tiles are small (title, 1–2 line impact, one metric, 8–10 word customer quote). Goal: production-ready snippets that we can drop into slides and the one-pager PDF.

Please do the following by EOW (Friday):
- Draft 2 concise tiles each (3–4 sentences total per tile) using the attached template.
- Flag any required legal wording / approvals per customer.
- Attach any signed releases if you have them; if not, include the exact quote we should send to the customer for sign-off.

Attached: onepager-snippet-template.docx (very small).

Priority targets: Acme (large, low latency win), Finbot (embedding & retrieval improvement), two mid-market wins if you have them. If you need me to intro to the customer contact for approval, I’ll do it.

Thanks — short and punchy wins are what sells here.

—Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-07-24T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capture compact customer wins for one-pager tile gallery

Naomi —

Attached is a draft for Acme (acme-win-draft.txt). Short version below — please let me know if you want me to route to Jordan for approval or you prefer to send.

Acme Industries — Retail analytics pipeline
- 1-line impact: Cut inference cost by 42% while reducing 95th percentile latency from 780ms to 320ms in production.
- Metric: 42% cost reduction, 2.4x latency improvement (P95).
- Quote (draft): “Redwood let us scale personalized search without sacrificing speed.” — Jordan Price, Head of ML, Acme

Notes: customer prefers brief quote approval rather than full legal release; I can ping Jordan with the exact wording. Attaching the draft and a short screenshot they shared (see Drive link).

Attachment: acme-win-draft.txt

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-07-25T08:23:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Acme tile draft for one-pager — quick approval request

Jordan — forwarding a 1-line tile we're hoping to include in an internal/external one-pager and a small slide gallery. Would you mind confirming the quote and the metrics below? If you prefer alternate wording or a redaction, tell us and we'll update. If it looks good, could you please reply with "Approved" and attach the signed release if that’s easier for procurement?

Quoted text (from Marissa):
> Acme Industries — Retail analytics pipeline
> - 1-line impact: Cut inference cost by 42% while reducing 95th percentile latency from 780ms to 320ms in production.
> - Metric: 42% cost reduction, 2.4x latency improvement (P95).
> - Quote (draft): “Redwood let us scale personalized search without sacrificing speed.” — Jordan Price, Head of ML, Acme

Thanks for a quick look. We’ll only publish after your sign-off.

—Naomi

From: Jordan Price <jordan.price@acme.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-07-26T14:55:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Acme tile draft for one-pager — quick approval request

Naomi / Marissa —

Thanks for sending this over. The numbers look correct but please redact the absolute P95 numbers and leave the relative improvement and percent cost figure. So change to: “42% cost reduction and 2.4x P95 latency improvement.” That keeps our internal telemetry semantics consistent. The quote is fine — please use the shorter form: "Redwood helped us scale personalized search without sacrificing speed."

I’ve attached a signed testimonial release for use in marketing. Feel free to reach out if you need legal to sign anything else.

Attachment: acme_testimonial_release.pdf

Approved.

—Jordan Price
Head of ML, Acme Industries
jordan.price@acme.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-07-28T15:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capture compact customer wins for one-pager tile gallery

Perfect — Jordan approved and attached the signed release. Marissa, I updated the tile text per Jordan's redaction and pushed the approved version to the Drive link (see related_links). Ben/Steph — can you slot this one into the enterprise one-pager master (slide 3 tile #1)?

Stephanie — any luck on the Finbot tile? If you can attach the snippet and any approvals, we’ll aim to ship the one-pager to Growth next Tuesday.

Thanks all — small, customer-validated wins will make the deck pop.

Attachment: finbot-snippet.docx (will be added by Stephanie)

—Naomi
